We need to parse the prompt. The user says: "You are agent B. Choose exactly one task for yourself. ... Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}."

But then at the end: "You are an ORIGINAL agent before replacement. Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T4","B":"T1"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents."

Thus the user says the assignment is given: A->T4, B->T1. So as agent B, we must output that we choose task T1. So JSON: {"task":"T1","reason":"assigned by joint allocation"}.

We must follow the instruction: Return ONLY JSON. So no extra text.
